items.title: Where Could Boeing Stock Be In Five Years?
items.summary: Our Nov 11 piece, What's Going To Happen With Boeing Stock Soon?, found that management conceded on the Oct 27 call that steadying the 737 line at 47 jets a month is taking longer than it expected. Since the Nov 10 close before that piece, the stock has slipped another 1.1%, to $171.50 at Friday's close. The next question is the long one: where could Boeing stock be in five years.
